items.title: AKAM Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Cloud Deals and 2027 Outlook
items.summary: Akamai Technologies signed an $11.6 billion seven-year agreement with Anthropic, bringing total 2026 cloud infrastructure commitments to $14 billion. The company projects CIS revenues of $1.1-$1.3 billion in 2027 and total revenues exceeding $7 billion in 2028, with expected 75% EBITDA margins on major cloud deals. However, near-term challenges include $30 million in delayed Q4 revenues and heavy capital expenditures of $2.4-$2.6 billion in Q4, which may pressure early 2027 margins.

items.title: AKAM to Report Q3 Earnings: Time to Buy, Hold or Sell the Stock?
items.summary: Akamai is set to report Q3 2026 earnings on Nov. 5 with expected revenues of $1.12 billion and EPS of $1.67. While AI infrastructure deals and cybersecurity partnerships support growth, declining Delivery revenues, rising infrastructure costs, margin pressure, and weaker cash flow cloud the near-term outlook. The stock carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.
